statement: Complete evaluation of the marked central Frobenius parameter as a countable product of Z3, with exact finite orbit presentations, all transition maps and constructive coherent-character coordinates and inverse.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d); actual single marked cusp of E41.1
notes: The exact module is C/(q^2 theta2-1)C, with C the completed exterior square of Z3[[B]] and B=Pi/I_Q. The compact operator image is already closed.
Every finite orbit factor has order3^(v3(q-1)+v3(L)); orientations and all transition units epsilon*q^(-2j) are retained.
Alternating mod3 invariant measures vanish because the only periodic point of B^2 is(1,1). This proves torsion-freeness of the inverse-limit cokernel, despite its finite torsion quotients.

Characteristic clopen annuli provide infinitely many independent continuous order-three characters. Finite orbit growth supplies actual division-by3 of every finite character; coherent chains give the product coordinates and their inverse.
The q4 full rank9 mod3 quotient and the primitive arithmetic scalar quotient are kept separate. The latter has a closed orbit-count formula at all positional levels and is checked through729.
The product map is noncanonical and defined from the actual finite Frobenius permutations. The theorem assigns no guessed coefficient to an unevaluated higher Frobenius word.

Root independently audited the full proof and freshly reran copied code. The complete JSON is identical with no field omitted. All finite orbit formulas, torsion-freeness, explicit character division and the product-coordinate inverse passed.
